name: app-navy-user-flow-tree-with-phone-and-italic-serif-headline
title: Navy User Flow Tree beside Phone
whatItIs: A white slide with a User Flow pill, a headline mixing light sans and bold italic serif, a fintech phone at left and a rounded-pill tree at right with navy nodes for Sign Up, Navigation, Discover and Event and pale nodes for sub-screens.
whatItMeans: Navy filled nodes mark main screens while pale ones recede, so the structure reads at once.
techniques: Filled navy nodes for primary screens
Pale outlined nodes for secondary screens
Soft shadowed pills with elbow connectors
Phone as a visual anchor at left

vocabulary.definition: A filled pill representing a main screen.
A pale pill representing a sub-screen.
A picture placed beside a diagram to ground it.
